column1: # Compile-only probes of the 3502 function-coercion rule after Epic's answers to followup-coerce (#724): a function value that is no function named where its type is expected (a result, a field, a call's result, an array, a map, a tuple's element, an argument of a generic call), int/rational and void results, class variance of values, a parametric class's method at any. UEFN 43.12 (++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086) compiled each alone on 2026-11-19 (~17:40Z): epic_outcome, epic_lines (1-based lines of the probe file, the header included) and its diagnostics in note, with OpenVerse's verdict (Lean and C agreeing) after this round: int to rational no longer exempt, a function named at a void result or from a void parameter admitted, the type errors Epic gives as 3502 citing it. 16 of 17 agreed; value-class-result differed (class variance of a function value, as followup-coerce's value-class-variance) until openverse made adapters for it: 17 agree now.
